g.text: XDL five arms + legacy anchors, seed3407
Paired contraction and actual-GT endpoint accuracy
ρ < 1 means reduced response to the same-event prior perturbation; it does not prove GT accuracy or closed-loop recovery.
Each point uses every frozen large probe (24 packets/sequence); no uncertainty intervals or selected subsets.
